def cache(timeout, key_func=None):
    ...
    def decorator(func):
        cache = {}
        @wraps(func)
        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
            ...
        def invalidate(*args, **kwargs):
            cache.pop(key_func(*args, **kwargs), None)

        return wrapper
    return decorator
```
